title: Illumina MiSeq Dual Index Amplicon Sequencing Sample Preparation for Bacterial 16S rRNA Gene
author: Alexander Eiler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qytdxwn
materials: Quantification: using gel analyzer program or PicoGreen assay

steps.title: Set up first PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare first‑PCR reactions (triplicate or duplicate per sample) using Illumina‑adapted bacterial primers 341F and 805R (forward: ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCTNNNNCCTACGGGNGGCWGCAG; reverse: AGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCTGACTACNVGGGTATCTAATCC) and Q5 High‑Fidelity DNA Polymerase (500 U, NEB catalog #M0491L). Run the PCR with an initial denaturation of 3 minutes, annealing at 48 °C (as recommended for unbiased amplification), and the remaining cycling conditions recommended by the polymerase manufacturer.

steps.title: Check first PCR on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Optional: run 1 % agarose gel electrophoresis to verify the presence and size of the first‑PCR amplicons.

steps.title: Pool and bead‑purify first PCR
steps.instruction: Combine the duplicate (or triplicate) first‑PCR reactions for each sample, then purify the pooled amplicons with Agencourt AMPure magnetic beads (or a comparable bead‑based cleanup).

substeps.instruction: Optional: run a second 1 % agarose gel to assess purification quality.

steps.title: Set up second PCR with indexed primers
steps.instruction: Prepare second‑PCR reactions to attach Illumina sequencing adapters and dual indices. Use the multiplex forward primer (AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGA{TCTACAC}-[i5 index]‑ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACG) and multiplex reverse primer (CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT-[i7 index]‑GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT). Choose i5 and i7 index primers from the available set of 20 forward and 20 reverse barcoded primers (up to 400 unique tag combinations). Run the second‑PCR program as described in Table 2 of the protocol.

steps.title: Check second PCR on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Run 1 % agarose gel electrophoresis for 00:01:00 (1 hour) to confirm successful amplification and correct amplicon size.

steps.title: Bead‑purify second PCR
steps.instruction: Purify the second‑PCR products with Agencourt AMPure magnetic beads. Optionally verify the purified product on a 1 % agarose gel.

steps.title: Quantify and calculate pooling volumes
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA concentration (ng/µL) of each purified sample. Determine the target DNA amount (ng) using the lowest‑concentration sample (its concentration × its volume). For each sample, calculate the volume needed to reach the target amount: volume = target ng / sample concentration (ng/µL). Use the same pipette for all calculations to minimise pipette‑calibration error.

steps.title: Pool samples in equal amounts
steps.instruction: Pipette the calculated volume of each sample into a single tube, creating a pooled library with equal DNA mass (ng) per sample, or equal molecule number (mol) for amplicons of differing length.

steps.title: Gel‑purify pool and re‑quantify
steps.instruction: Perform gel purification of the pooled library, then re‑quantify the purified pool using PicoGreen fluorescence before submitting to the sequencing facility.
